key_points: UPS CEO announces 50% cut to Amazon parcel volume, lowering near‑term revenue outlook
Bank of America cuts price target to $108 and trims FY earnings forecast, reinforcing downside bias
Stock slipped ~4% over two days as market digests lower volume and earnings guidance
Potential dual labor strikes in 2028 add longer‑term risk but not immediate catalyst
Despite high dividend yield and cheap valuation metrics, short‑term headwinds dominate
